name: Bitterroot River (Stevensville)
blurb: Gentle valley float with Bitterroot peaks for a backdrop. Infamous for shifting logjams.

sections.notes: Channels braid and wood moves every year — heads-up floating.
Check recent obstruction reports — strainers are common here.
sections.distanceReview: The existing 9-mile figure conflicts with the FWP centerline (about 10 miles between these facility locations). The map is approximate; float-time estimates await a reviewed landing-to-landing distance.

sections.notes: Last valley miles into town. Still woody. Stay off new side channels you can't see through.
sections.accessReview: The intended Buckhouse Bridge take-out and legal river-side landing have not been confirmed. Choose another documented exit before planning this stretch.

notices.title: Buckhouse public-access proposal
notices.text: The June 2025 MDT US 93 study describes proposed public access near Buckhouse Bridge and concerns about highway-side parking. A proposal does not confirm a completed public take-out or legal parking and approach. Confirm a documented exit before planning this listing.
notices.sourceName: Montana MDT — US 93 Missoula to Florence final study, printed page 47
